Description: Responsible for authenticating customers with login and password and managing the complete session lifecycle, including session creation, unique session identification, expiration, logout invalidation, and access validation for restricted functionality.

Responsible for maintaining the flight-search domain information required by the application, including registered airports, routes and flight options, and for providing fast one-way and round-trip searches with departure times, arrival times, and reference fares.

Responsible for creating, listing, consulting, and canceling customer flight reservations, supporting one-way and round-trip bookings, generating unique reservation identifiers, recording booking dates, and maintaining the current active state of reservations consistently.

Responsible for providing and updating each customer's own profile and contact information, including phone data and address, while enforcing customer data isolation and requiring current-password confirmation for profile changes.
Responsible for providing read-only customer loyalty information, including loyalty status, miles accumulated during the year, and total accumulated miles.

Responsible for preparing and resetting the application environment for tests, demonstrations, and operational reinitialization, including generating configurable example customers, recreating core operational data, and aggregating basic counts for customers, sessions, flights, routes, reservations, and airports without direct database inspection.
